summary: propose filing of inbox/ items into tasks or wiki; human approves | drafts: promote agent-drafted notes
hints: Propose filing of inbox/ items into a task or note; the human approves. `plainkeep triage drafts` pages agent-drafted notes (author:agent, status:draft) from `plainkeep files distill` as a promotion queue: accept -> active, reject -> delete, one git commit each. --json lists proposals/drafts without acting. Common mistake: expecting it to auto-file without --approved.

actions.name: propose
actions.summary: page inbox/ items and file each (interactive; `plainkeep triage`, no keyword). --json lists proposals without acting; use `decide` to apply headless

actions.name: decide
actions.summary: non-interactively file ONE inbox item (the headless apply path)

args.name: decision
args.help: file as a task, a note, or skip it

actions.name: drafts
actions.summary: promote agent-drafted notes (interactive). --json lists them; nested `drafts decide <slug> accept|reject|skip` applies one headless
